name: Steamed rice cakes
summary: Small steamed cups Du lịch Phú Yên says are not the bánh bèo of other places. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang tops them with fried bread, pork floss, and scallion fat, and finishes with sweet-sour fish sauce. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Tuy Hoa. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang and its food roundup describe the local cup.
texture: The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang says the cups are fragrant and chewy. The food roundup says the batter is rice flour, steamed in a small cup.
howToEat: Spoon sweet-sour fish sauce into the hot cup and eat it from the cup. The cẩm nang’s topping is fried bread, pork floss, and scallion fat. The food roundup’s topping is pork floss, crisp fried bread, and chives, with bánh hỏi added if you want it. Both stay. Hours are Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: At the foot of Núi Nhạn. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang’s streets are Lê Trung Kiên and Tản Đà.
seoTitle: Banh beo in Tuy Hoa — small cups at the foot of Nui Nhan
seoDescription: Steamed rice cups with fried bread, pork floss, and scallion fat, at the foot of Nui Nhan. Not the Hue set. A price is Check on arrival.
